g-k-drives.note: Only the board counts for mastery. Noses, jets and reactors don't, so there's one tick per board.

g-kitguns.note: Only the chamber counts for mastery. Grips and loaders don't, so there's one tick per chamber.

g-tauron.note: Tauron Strikes don't count toward mastery. These ticks are only for tracking which Tektolyst Artifacts you've collected.
